profiles.title: CH340G USB-serial bridge, SOP-16 (LCSC C14267, measured on the live editor)
profiles.source: measured 2026-10-03: C14267 placed at (300,500) on test/P24 (probe page fa96410e884cc55f); sch.component_pins answered all 16 pins at x=260 (pins 1-8) and x=340 (pins 9-16), y from 535 down to 465 in steps of 10, every PinLength 10; its own bbox was [269.5,454.5,330.5,545.5] -> body (-30.5,-45.5,30.5,45.5). Pin names are the host's own: GND/TXD/RXD/V3/UD+/UD-/XI/XO on the left face, CTS#/DSR#/RI#/DCD#/DTR#/RTS#/R232/VCC on the right face — both the UART pair and the USB data pair are on the LEFT, unlike 098's hand-written sample (a fact of this symbol; the presentation declares the sides it draws). Evidence: outputs/099/libprobe/pins_ch340g.json + 08_geometry_probe.json

profiles.title: 12 MHz HC-49S crystal, THT two-pin (LCSC C389706, measured)
profiles.source: measured 2026-10-03: C389706 (5S0-1200A2020-00, footprint HC-49S_L11.0-W4.4-P4.88) placed at (600,500) on test/P24; sch.component_pins answered pin 1 'OSC1' at (580,500) and pin 2 'OSC2' at (620,500), both PinLength 10; its own bbox was [589.5,492.5,610.5,507.5] -> body (-10.5,-7.5,10.5,7.5). Two pins on opposite sides, 40 units apart. Evidence: outputs/099/libprobe/pins_xtal.json + 08_geometry_probe.json

profiles.title: 22pF 0603 C0G (LCSC C140958, measured)
profiles.source: measured 2026-10-03: C140958 (C0603C220J2GAC7867, footprint C0603) placed at (800,500) on test/P24; sch.component_pins answered pin 1 at (820,500) (Rotation 0) and pin 2 at (780,500) (Rotation 180), both PinLength 10; its own bbox was [789.5,491.5,810.5,508.5] -> body (-10.5,-8.5,10.5,8.5). Note the pin order: at the host's own rotation 0, pin 1 leaves on the RIGHT — the library profile states the measured shape, not an assumed one. Evidence: outputs/099/libprobe/pins_c22p.json + 08_geometry_probe.json

profiles.title: PWR-VCC
profiles.source: flag glyph convention of the compiler (the host places a power flag by kind+net, never from a library profile). Measured on the live host 2026-10-03 for the family: the Power flag placed at (300,300) with net VCC resolves to the host symbol 'Power-5V', has its connection point AT the origin (PinLength 5) and its glyph 4.5..10.5 units ABOVE it (bbox [294.5,304.5,305.5,310.5]); the Ground flag at (600,300) has its connection point at the origin (PinLength 10) and its bars 9.5..19.5 units BELOW it ([589.5,280.5,610.5,290.5]) — pit 43's two families, re-measured this batch. Evidence: outputs/099/libprobe/pins_flag_vcc.json + 08_geometry_probe.json
